observations: Initial editor displayed Map and Key with two tokens.
Zoom in changed the badge to 150 percent; zoom out changed it to 80 percent.
Screenshots at 150 and 80 percent showed the same token boxes and apparently unchanged letter size, so the claimed view magnification was not visually demonstrated.
Reveal states scale 0.8 while stored words stay unchanged; both buttons disabled after one use.
whyCool: A view can change without changing the underlying document.
caveat: The tested view did not visibly scale, so the central interaction needs repair.
effort: Prediction, zoom in and out, comparison screenshots and reveal.
bucketReason: Zoom percentage changes without a visible zoom effect.

prediction.reason: The hook explicitly states the answer.
prediction.evidence: Larger letters do not add text; unchanged stored text.

interaction.reason: The numerical scale changes but the defining visual effect is missing.
interaction.evidence: Same rendered tokens at 150 and 80 percent.

payoff.reason: Correct conceptual statement lacks its promised visual evidence.
payoff.evidence: View and document state described separately.

clarity.reason: Zoom labels contradict an unchanged rendering.

transfer.evidence: Magnification and content are separate state.

surprise.evidence: Words remain the same as promised.

visualExplanation.evidence: Same size token text and boxes in both screenshots.

practicalValue.evidence: Zoom does not edit document content.
